terms.comment: Classically a helmet of metal, as galea was first one of leather (Lewis & Short s.v. cassis, after Isidore); in use the two are not kept apart.

phrases.latin: Galeam indue. Genuālia et cubitālia indue.
phrases.english: Put on your helmet, knee pads and elbow pads.

sources: Lewis & Short: galea · Morgan–Owens: Silva
